objective: Explain why the existing SETUP_03 state machine produces material platform/event lifecycle divergence across the adjacent 3% to 4% and 4% to 5% platform-tolerance pairs; do not search for or select a tolerance.

historical_structure_symptom_evidence.source: tracked PR #29 capsule and report only
allowed_metrics: exact retained/retention independent of residual assignment

production_semantics.implementation: reuse the production SETUP_03 state-machine path
production_semantics.instrumentation: read-only research wrapper or read-only diagnostics only
production_semantics.as_of_rule: trace at bar t may use only data with index <= t and swings with confirmed_index <= t

first_divergence_bar.definition: For the same symbol and adjacent tolerance pair, the earliest aligned bar at which one or more correctness-relevant equivalence fields differ after all earlier aligned bars were equivalent.

ordered_primary_rules.when: at the first divergence bar only high_span gate pass/fail differs across the adjacent thresholds
at the first divergence bar only low_span gate pass/fail differs across the adjacent thresholds
at the first divergence bar both high_span and low_span gate pass/fail differ across the adjacent thresholds
at the first divergence bar the confirmed swing identity set, high/low counts, or market-structure classification differs and the new-swing eligibility predicate does not differ
at the first divergence bar new-confirmed-swing eligibility differs
at the first divergence bar platform_detected_this_bar or detected_index differs and no earlier rule applies
at the first divergence bar frozen breakout_price differs and no earlier rule applies
at the first divergence bar frozen structural_invalidation differs and no earlier rule applies
at the first divergence bar terminal type/date, confirmed_index, setup_state, or last_terminal_index differs and no earlier rule applies
the first divergence is real but none of the frozen ordered rules applies

ordered_rules.when: the root divergence has no downstream divergent lifecycle
all descendants arise through divergent last_terminal_index and re-arm timing only
all descendants arise through frozen breakout/invalidation anchor differences only
all descendants arise through new-swing eligibility differences only
two or more propagation mechanisms occur or a descendant mechanism changes stage

lifecycle_lineage.ordinal_rule: within symbol and tolerance, order lifecycles by first detected bar, then terminal bar, then frozen breakout, then frozen invalidation; ordinals are one-based
lifecycle_lineage.matching_rule: match exact same detection root first; then classify one-to-many as SPLIT, many-to-one as MERGE, unmatched higher-tolerance as ADDED_LIFECYCLE, unmatched lower-tolerance as DISAPPEARED_LIFECYCLE, and causally downstream unmatched items as CASCADE_DESCENDANT

experiments.intervention: hold lower-tolerance last_terminal_index fixed while changing only the tolerance gate
experiments.measure: reduction in downstream divergent lifecycle count

experiments.intervention: hold the lower-tolerance first detection bar fixed while allowing the higher tolerance
hold lower-tolerance frozen breakout and invalidation anchors fixed
suppress terminal-index propagation by feeding the lower-tolerance terminal index into subsequent higher-tolerance re-arm eligibility
experiments.measure: count of originally added/disappeared downstream lifecycles restored to concordance

historical_symptom_concordance.classification_rule: CONCORDANT when every available allowed direction/sign and sparse/concentration structural symptom agrees; PARTIALLY_CONCORDANT when at least one agrees and at least one disagrees; DISCORDANT when available comparable symptoms all disagree; INSUFFICIENT when no allowed comparable symptom exists.

research_evidence_state.classification_rule: Emit the observed root ranking, concentration pattern, cascade structure, coverage, and unresolved OTHER count as a machine-readable rationale; do not invent a numeric post-result threshold. CLEAR_SINGLE_MECHANISM requires an unambiguous dominant mechanism across market and pair slices without material contradiction; ROOT_CAUSE_WITH_STRONG_CASCADE_AMPLIFICATION additionally requires the same root to produce visibly multi-lifecycle downstream propagation; MIXED_CAUSAL_STRUCTURE applies when material roots or slice conclusions conflict; INSUFFICIENT_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE applies when trace, parity, coverage, or classification is inadequate.

parity_requirements.comparison_base: current origin/main at execution time, recorded by exact commit SHA
parity_requirements.mismatch_policy: treat any mismatch as a correctness bug and fix it without changing the frozen research rules

output_schema.row_order: market, symbol, adjacent lower tolerance, adjacent upper tolerance, root lifecycle ordinal, bar index, lineage class
output_schema.canonical_json: UTF-8, object keys sorted, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false, NaN and Infinity prohibited

stop_conditions: instrumentation cannot be completed without changing production semantics
the exact frozen holdout has an authenticity problem
a new real governance blocker is found
attribution has formed a Sol structural decision

integrity.hash_scope: canonical JSON with the complete integrity object omitted
